crossRefs.note: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

translations.web: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
translations.bsb: A club is regarded as straw, and he laughs at the sound of the lance.
translations.kjv: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
translations.asv: Clubs are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the rushing of the javelin.
